name: Emin Yusuf AYDIN
institution: Tellus Araştırma Geliştirme ve Mühendislik A.Ş.
phd_thesis_title: Modeling the Role of Active Sensing Movements in Weakly Electric Fish During Refuge Tracking Behavior
about: I completed my PhD in Bioengineering at Hacettepe University. My doctoral thesis, titled ‘Modeling the Role of Active Sensing Movements in Weakly Electric Fish During Refuge Tracking Behavior,’ investigated active sensing, multisensory integration, and sensorimotor control in weakly electric fish using closed-loop behavioral experiments, computational modeling, and system identification.

My current research interests span systems and behavioral neuroscience, electrophysiology, neural sensing, bioinspired robotics, control systems, and the translation of biological sensing principles into engineering applications.
I currently work as R&D personnel at Tellus Araştırma Geliştirme ve Mühendislik A.Ş. in Ankara, while continuing my research on active sensing, sensorimotor control, and bioinspired sensing systems.
